errors.evidence: The description states there are nine semantic dependency labels, but the legend in the figure clearly shows eleven different categories.
The color representing EXP in the legend is orange, not brown (棕色).
The color for MEAS in the legend is a dark grey. The light grey color represents PAT. The description incorrectly assigns the light grey color to MEAS.

errors.text_span: 在所有类别中，AGT（蓝色）柱状图高度普遍最高
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization. In the first category on the x-axis ("避免"), the bar for CONT (dark blue) is visibly taller than the bar for AGT.

errors.text_span: 在“回避”和“逃避”类别中接近37.00%
errors.evidence: While the AGT value for "回避" is close to 37.00%, its value for "逃避" is only around 30.50%, which is not close to 37.00%.

errors.text_span: CONT（深蓝色）在“避免”和“规避”类别中高度接近35.00%
errors.evidence: While the CONT value for "避免" is close to 35.00% (approx. 36.5%), its value for "规避" is only about 22.5%, which is not close to 35.00%.

errors.text_span: 其他标签如PAT、TIME、LOC、MEAS、eCOO、eSUCC在所有类别中的柱高普遍低于10.00%
errors.evidence: This statement is an over-generalization that misses a significant data point. The bar for MEAS in the "规避" category is approximately 15.5%, which is substantially higher than 10.00%.
